foundation.name: authoritative game state plus deterministic intent-resolution/save composition
foundation.why: The law is proven in RTSBenchmark but remains sample-specific; no reusable life-sim world authority exists.

boundedGlue: typed stable game IDs with explicit Dominatus AgentId mapping
authoritative GameState for grid, entities, inventory, crops, economy, relationships, time, and RNG state
typed GameIntent emitted by human and AI controllers
deterministic phase loop and resolver copied as a pattern from RTSBenchmark
game save chunk composed with Dominatus checkpoint/replay at a stable tick boundary
immutable presentation snapshot consumed by a temporary MonoGame adapter
later Machina world/HUD composition and input arbitration adapter
optional compact snapshot-file adapter for Oblivion
